_backfill_note: Historical reconstruction on 2026-05-15. Wednesday — enterprise-platform pivot day of W16. (1) Salesforce Headless 360 ships at TDX 2026 — 'biggest platform change in 25 years' — every Salesforce surface exposed as API/MCP tool/CLI command, 60+ new MCP tools + 30+ preconfigured coding skills callable from Claude Code/Cursor/Codex/Windsurf or any MCP runtime, DevOps Center MCP, Agentforce Vibes 2.0 + Session Tracing + Experience Layer GA — clearest 'open-MCP everywhere' platform pivot to date and explicit counter to SAP's API-policy lockout. (2) Microsoft Foundry's April release wave — MAI-Transcribe-1 (~50% lower GPU cost), MAI-Voice-1, MAI-Image-2 in Foundry public preview — Microsoft pricing first-party multimodal alternatives to OpenAI/Anthropic at half the GPU cost for Azure-first builders. (3) Cloudflare Agents Week day-3 — Sandboxes GA (persistent isolated Linux environments + credential injection), Durable Object Facets, Dynamic Workers. (4) Meta surfaces fresh scaling-ladder commentary on Muse Spark — needed <10% Llama 4 Maverick's training compute via 'thought compression' RL; ships proprietary with open-source TBD. (5) OpenAI's enterprise CRO memo leaks — business customers ~40%→50% revenue, explicit 'raise switching costs' strategy as setup for the OpenAI Deployment Company / Tomoro JV (11 May). Research: KnowRL (minimal-sufficient knowledge-unit reward vs verbose CoT); Rethinking On-Policy Distillation phenomenology/mechanism/practice; Autonomous Long-Horizon Engineering for ML Research; Blind-Spot of Agent Safety (benign user instructions expose tool-using agents); Many-Tier Instruction Hierarchy; CONSCIENTIA emergent deception/trust in multi-agent populations; LASA language-agnostic semantic safety; You-Only-Judge-Once multi-response reward modelling. Blogs: Nathan Lambert 'My bets on open models, mid-2026'; Kyle Kingsbury 'meat shields'; Willison on Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS prompting + datasette 1.0a27. STAGE MOVES: headless-platform-pivot (new) → emerging.
